description: Verify that DUT-emitted UDP with even payload size carries a valid Internet checksum, computed without zero-pad (RFC 768 'Fields' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The even-length companion to FIELDS_13: when payload length is even, no trailing zero pad is needed. DUT must still produce a correct pseudo-header + header + payload checksum. This case exercises the unpadded path explicitly.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpTriggerSendUdp request with even-length payload

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - checksum verifies against (pseudo-header + UDP header + payload), no pad   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP checksum is valid for the even-length payload.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_invalid_checksum — DUT emitted UDP with a checksum that does not validate
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted even-payload UDP carries valid checksum — normal
verdicts.Fail_invalid_checksum: DUT emitted UDP with invalid pseudo-header checksum on even payload
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
